evidence: Hafnium proﬁles were accessed by medium energy ion scattering (MEIS) of 100 keV H+ ions. Hf areal densities were determined by Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy (RBS) of 1 MeV He+ ions and Al areal densities by NRP using the resonance at 992 keV of the 27Al/p, 28Si nuclear reaction. Low energy ion scattering (LEIS) of 2 keV He+ ions was used to investigate changes in the surface composition of the ﬁlms induced by postdeposition annealing. Analysis of the near-interface regions of the Si substrate after RTA with back-secondary-ion-mass spectroscopy (not shown) revealed the migration of very small amounts of Hf and Al into this region.
